name: Earnings Relay — the year-over-year comparator, and nothing else
notes: This plan is written and deliberately not run. src/earnings-relay/ works today on the 2026-09-06 recordings, with the PRD's default year-over-year comparator resolving to metric_status=unknown because recorded/ holds only four trailing quarters per symbol. Running this tier flips that comparator from unknown to computable.

Cost: /v2/financials/quarterly/{symbol}/ bills 1 credit per quarter returned (mock_server.cost_for, 'per quarter returned'), so n_quarters=8 is 8 credits per symbol and this whole tier is 64 of the ~623 credits remaining.

Every symbol here came back in an earlier response: all eight appear in recorded/v2_companies_quarterly-financial-dates__limit-30.json, which is the merged 960-row sweep already paid for. A guessed identifier 404s and a 404 bills 1 credit.
n_quarters is explicit on every call. Letting it default is how a defaulted-parameter call costs more than the one that was intended (CLAUDE.md).

The four symbols in tier 0 are the ones recorded/ already holds at n_quarters=4; re-fetching them at 8 supersedes those files rather than adding to them. Commit the new recordings with their ledger entry, and note in research/audit/ that the four-quarter payloads are now a strict subset.

Rehearse against the mock first: cd research/harness && SECTORS_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787 python3 src/capture.py --plan plans/plan-earnings-relay.json --budget 64 --dry-run. Delete anything a mock rehearsal writes into recorded/ before going live.

After running it: src/earnings-relay/sources.py's check_series_depth gate FAILS on purpose ('year-over-year became computable on recorded data'), which is the reminder to switch the demo workspace's comparator back to the PRD default and re-run ./run.sh test.
